title: Topfeild Equestrian Center

services.name: Horse Leaders
services.desc: Enjoy a FREE tour and scavenger hunt of Topfield Center's barn and grounds, and learn more about our programs. Brighten your Saturday with a visit to Topfield, where you can meet our sixteen equines while exploring our beautiful grounds. We’ll start with a tour of our grounds and pastures, offering expansive views of the Hudson Highlands. Then, we’ll head over to our barn to explore our facilities and meet our horses, donkey, and two barn cats. Along the way, you'll learn how Topfield supports the community through grooming, riding, physical therapy, psychotherapy, and speech therapy programs. Kids can enjoy a fun scavenger hunt during the tour. We hope you can join us! Please let us know
